HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #16
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Name the president
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

2. Which statement about Internal conflicts in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Internal conflicts in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Internal conflicts in Africa.
   C. Explain Internal conflicts in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Internal conflicts in Africa as rumours only.

3. Which statement about Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya as rumours only.
   B. Explain Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya.

7. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Littering in markets

8. Which statement about French Revolutions is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain French Revolutions with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say French Revolutions never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing French Revolutions.
   D. Treat French Revolutions as rumours only.

9. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Mombasa
   C. Nairobi
   D. Nakuru

   A. Say Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship never happens in Kenya.

14. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)

   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
